name: lesswrong-mcp
description: Read-only research tools for LessWrong and the Alignment Forum: posts, discussions, people, wiki tags, sequences, links, reactions, edit history and search.
long_description: Reads only what the forums show to logged-out visitors. Never writes, votes or logs in. Requests are spaced, cached and capped to stay polite to the forum.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Turn post titles, people's names, topics and sequence titles into exact ids, with ranked candidates.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search of posts, comments, people, wiki pages and sequences, with filters.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: A post's metadata, status, reviews and text, with an outline and sections.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: A discussion as ranked threads, with disagreement signals and reply maps.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Posts filtered by person, tag, dates, AF and status, best first or by date.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Comments by a person, recent comments site-wide, or quick takes.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: A person's public profile with their top and latest posts, latest comments and wiki edits.

tools.name: get_tag
tools.description: A wiki page's text, structure, likes and top tagged posts.

tools.name: get_sequence
tools.description: A sequence's posts in reading order, or a collection's books.

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: All public sequences, a person's sequences, or curated sequences.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Edit history of a post, comment or wiki page, or a person's wiki edits: versions, original, texts and diffs.

tools.name: first_use
tools.description: Earliest verifiable use of a phrase, checked against edit history.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Posts linking to a post, wiki pages linking to a page, and the links in a text.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Karma, votes, agreement, likes and reactions on a post, comment or wiki page, in detail.

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Front page (approximate), recent discussion, popular comments, quick takes, Best of LessWrong and other feeds.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The site's tags that can be applied to posts, or all tags grouped under a core tag.
